title: Southern Ocean Shapes for MEASO work.
text: goal measoshapes provide regions Marine Ecosystem Assessment Southern Ocean (MEASO): five sectors (Atlantic, Central Indian, East Indian, West Pacific, East Pacific), three zones (Antarctic, Subantarctic, Northern), described MEASO Summary Policymakers (see References). current version regions 06. Version 05 kept released. Website: https://australianantarcticdivision.github.io/measoshapes/

title: Southern Ocean Shapes for MEASO work.
text: map regions base plotting (sf package). one row per region, name, label, sector, zone, fill colour. _coastline form Antarctic continent cut .  temperate (T) regions north sector outside MEASO fill.

title: Southern Ocean Shapes for MEASO work.
text: use literal fill colours need scale_fill_identity(), ggplot’s “straight-” mechanism.
code: library(ggplot2) ggplot(measo, aes(fill = fill)) + geom_sf(colour = "grey40") + scale_fill_identity()

title: Southern Ocean Shapes for MEASO work.
text: SOmap package provides simpler ways creating adding polar maps. map set knows projection , can forget transform data.
code: ## TODO: SOplot() no longer adds to the SOmap() plot with current SOmap, not evaluated for now library(SOmap) SOmap(trim = -32) ## set up a polar map ## set overlay to half-transparent SOplot(st_geometry(measo), border = NA, col = scales::alpha(measo$fill, 0.75))

Version 06, one row 20 regions: measo_regions06 polar Lambert Azimuthal Equal Area (use areas) measo_regions06_ll longitude/latitude measo_regions06_coastline, measo_regions06_ll_coastline Antarctic continent cut measo_names06 name, label, sector, zone, fill region longitude/latitude polygons defined planar longitude/latitude: boundaries follow parallels meridians, rather great circles. polar forms densified (0.2 degree) follow boundaries. longitude/latitude West Pacific regions two parts, either side anti-meridian. export shapefile:

title: Southern Ocean Shapes for MEASO work.
text: version 06 regions also provided files ‘inst/extdata’, created ‘data-raw/export.R’, one row region (20 rows) columns. also published website. measo_regions06.parquet, .fgb polar Lambert Azimuthal Equal Area (equivalent EPSG:6932), use areas measo_regions06_ll.parquet, .fgb, .geojson longitude/latitude (OGC:CRS84) measo_regions06_epsg_3031.parquet, .fgb Antarctic Polar Stereographic (EPSG:3031), e.g. Quantarctica measo_regions06.qml QGIS style fill colours labels geopackages (measo_regions.gpkg, measo_regions_ll.gpkg, measo_regions_epsg_3031.gpkg) version 05 files, kept .

title: Southern Ocean Shapes for MEASO work.
text: Version 05 kept released: measo_regions05, measo_regions05_ll, measo_regions05_coastline, measo_regions05_ll_coastline 24 polygons (geometry ) measo_names name, sector, zone, fill polygon, order WestPacific split anti-meridian, names appear twice measo_names key. join names geometry, group features name (removing seam anti-meridian) join distinct names. two WPA rows measo_names different fills (row 1 known error), takes first. northern regions assigned codes include “T” temperate, aren’t part MEASO. share sector assigned zone.
code: library(dplyr) measo05 <- measo_regions05 %>% group_by(name) %>% summarize() %>%   inner_join(distinct(measo_names, name, .keep_all = TRUE), "name") #> old-style crs object detected; please recreate object with a recent sf::st_crs() #> old-style crs object detected; please recreate object with a recent sf::st_crs() ## label positions from the (equal area) polar form cds <- st_coordinates(st_transform(st_centroid(measo_regions05), 4326)) #> old-style crs object detected; please recreate object with a recent sf::st_crs() #> old-style crs object detected; please recreate object with a recent sf::st_crs() #> old-style crs object detected; please recreate object with a recent sf::st_crs() par(mar = rep(0.2, 4)) plot(st_geometry(measo_regions05_ll), reset = FALSE,      col = colourvalues::colour_values(measo_names$sector, alpha = 0.5)) #> old-style crs object detected; please recreate object with a recent sf::st_crs() #> old-style crs object detected; please recreate object with a recent sf::st_crs() #> old-style crs object detected; please recreate object with a recent sf::st_crs() text(cds, lab = measo_names$name, cex = 0.7) maps::map(add = TRUE)

title: measoshapes 0.0.06
text: Release “06” adds measo_regions06 (_ll, _coastline _ll_coastline forms) measo_names06. boundaries version 05. version 06: one row per region (20 rows): WestPacific regions, split anti-meridian 05, one feature name, label, sector, zone, fill features; label full name, zone sector, e.g. “Antarctic Atlantic” fill colour region MEASO Summary Policymakers (Constable et al. 2023, Figure 5): sector hue, light dark Antarctic Northern zone current crs Version 05 kept released. colours sectors sharing palettes (WestPacific Atlantic, EastPacific CentralIndian), first WPA row measo_names fill doesn’t match second (error, kept released). Files version 06 ‘inst/extdata’: GeoParquet FlatGeobuf polar LAEA, longitude/latitude EPSG:3031, GeoJSON longitude/latitude, QGIS style. version 05 geopackages unchanged. Added references MEASO Summary Policymakers, McCormack et al. (2021), earlier MEASO documents (citation("measoshapes"), ?measo_regions06). Known: MEASO Summary Policymakers describes Northern zone “north 40°S”; Atlantic (9°W 10°E) Northern region (AON) reaches 38.3°S.
